text:
anya: late-night question — what movies do you rewatch when you can't sleep? looking for something calming, not too loud or scary :zzz:
marcus: 100% The Secret Life of Walter Mitty. quiet, pretty, and oddly reassuring. :popcorn:
kofi: Ohhh yes. also Amélie if you want something whimsical and gentle. the soundtrack is such a hug. :heart:
sam: For me it's actually the studio-ghibli mood. Kiki's Delivery Service or My Neighbor Totoro on low volume and I'm out in 90 mins. :sleeping:
taylor: If you like low stakes + cozy vibes, try The Hundred-Foot Journey. food + gentle pacing = perfect rewatch.
anya: love these. anyone have a very short list (2-3) for me to pick from tonight?
marcus: here —
```
1) The Secret Life of Walter Mitty — pretty landscapes, chill pacing
2) Amélie — whimsical, repeated scenes feel like a comfort blanket
3) Kiki's Delivery Service — soft, comforting soundtrack
```
kofi: +1 to that. also sometimes I do slow documentaries like Jiro Dreams of Sushi if I want something peaceful and focused.
movie-night-bot: Reminder: virtual movie watch party this Friday 8pm PST — #movie-night signups open. :bell:
anya: ooh thanks bot! for tonight i think i'll start with Amélie and keep the Ghibli on deck if insomnia persists. appreciate the recs y'all :raised_hands: 
sam: report back on which one did the trick :grin:
taylor: also pro tip — set your screen warm filter and play a low instrumental playlist on the side. helps me fall asleep faster than silence.
anya: will do. goodnight team (probably) :zzz:
